name: Record rear freehub (32-hole)
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed Record rear hub, 32-hole, 130 mm O.L.D., Campagnolo freehub body, without quick-release skewer. The 2017 Record table gives the 32-hole reference; the matching 2008 product-catalogue footnote explicitly excludes quick releases; the 2008 HB7/FH7 assembly drawing and 2017 code table identify this hub.
